# Stormboard

An online sticky note whiteboard making meetings, brainstorms, and creative projects more productive and effective.

Category: Productivity. Connect from any WhatEverFi bot at https://whateverfi.com/integrations/stormboard/.

## Actions

- **Close a Storm**: Close an open Storm, making it read-only.
- **Create a new chat message**: Create a new chat message in a Stormboard storm.
- **Create a New Storm**: Create a new Storm in Stormboard for interactive planning and collaboration.
- **Create an idea in Stormboard**: Create a new idea in an existing Stormboard storm.
- **Get a List of Ideas** (read-only): Retrieve all ideas from a Storm.
- **Get A List Of Participants** (read-only): Retrieve a list of all participants in a Storm.
- **Get A List Of Storms Invites** (read-only): Retrieve a list of storms that you have been invited to.
- **Get A List Of Your Storms** (read-only): Retrieve a list of storms from Stormboard.
- **Get Authentication Info** (read-only): Retrieve authentication information and API token for the authenticated user.
- **Get Chat Messages** (read-only): Retrieve a list of chat messages from a Stormboard storm.
- **Get Idea Data** (read-only): Retrieve detailed data and metadata for a specific idea.
- **Get Info About Your User** (read-only): Retrieve authenticated user profile information.
- **Get My Storm Access** (read-only): Check if the authenticated user has access to a Storm and retrieve their permission level.
- **Get Storm Details** (read-only): Retrieve detailed information about a specific Storm.
- **Get Unread Chat Messages** (read-only): Retrieve unread chat messages from a specific Storm.
- **Invite Participants to Storm**: Invite people to join a Storm by email.
- **Accept a Storm Invite**: Accept a Storm invitation and join the Storm.
- **Add a Favorite Star**: Add a favorite star to a Storm on the Dashboard.
- **Check Authentication** (read-only): Verify API key authentication validity.
- **Create a Line Connector**: Create a line connector between two ideas.
- **Create a New Tag**: Create a new tag in a Storm without any data related to Ideas.
- **Create a New User**: Create a new user account in Stormboard.
- **Create Tag Data for an Idea**: Update tag data for an idea.
- **Decline a Storm Invite**: Decline a Storm invitation and remove it from your list.
- **Delete a Connector Between Ideas**: Delete a line connector between two ideas.
- **Delete a Specific Connector**: Delete a line connector using the connector ID.
- **Duplicate a Storm**: Duplicate an existing Storm.
- **Get a list of connectors in a Storm** (read-only): Retrieve a list of connectors within a specific Storm.
- **Get List of Tags in Storm** (read-only): Retrieve the list of tags that have been created in a Storm.
- **Get Storm Template** (read-only): Retrieve template data for a Storm including all sections and subsections.
- **Get Tag Data For An Idea** (read-only): Retrieve tag data for a specific idea in Stormboard.
- **Join a Storm**: Join a Storm using its ID and access key.
- **Mark Chat Messages as Read**: Mark all chat messages as read in a Storm.
- **Remove a Favorite Star**: Remove a favorite star from a Storm on the Dashboard.
- **Reopen a Storm**: Reopen a closed Storm.
- **Update a Line Connector**: Update a specific line connector between two ideas.
- **Update Notifications**: Update user notification preferences.
- **Update Section in Storm**: Update a section's title, description, and/or character in a Storm.
- **Update Storm Legend**: Update the color labels of the legend for a storm.
- **Update Your Profile**: Update your user profile information.
- **Verify Your Account**: Verify a Stormboard account using a verification code.
